entry.title: Château de Montsoreau
entry.note: The exact-QID way/175416989 is the castle precinct, not an occupied building footprint. Its signed frame anchors the distinct northern ranges and open southern court. Do not stretch a single building mass to this boundary. Base datum, retaining walls and eastern/western extensions need terrain-context review. Preview uses the host terrain sample at the authored base; ground slope, facade azimuth and final site fit remain review items.

review: Explicit authoring proposal; registration is not geographic or maximum-fidelity approval.
